items.reason: Gap 0 describes two deliveries of the same event running at once, both passing the Set check before either inserts its id, so the charge is credited twice.
Gap 1 says the dedupe key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and a correctly signed body with a changed header is processed again.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the only refund handler is keyed refund.created, so every refund is dropped.
No gap depends on several processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns concurrency among queue jobs in one process.
